newsitem.title: USA: Summer Intertie rate of 6,900 MW recommended.
newsitem.headline: Summer Intertie rate of 6,900 MW recommended.

text.p: A technical study group convened by the Western Systems Coordinating Council (WSCC) is recommending a permanent summer rating of 6,900 megawatts (MW) for the Pacific Intertie power lines, a spokesman for the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Thursday.
BPA operates the Northwest portion of the Intertie system, which connects the region to Southern California.
An interim summer rating of 6,300 MW for the combined AC and DC segments of the Intertie was put in place on Tuesday.
Transmissions had been capped at 7,200 MW during the spring, but capacity was cut due to reliability concerns amid heavy summertime usage.
The BPA spokesman said the 6,300 MW rating will remain in effect until 6,900 MW is given final approval by the board of the WSCC, which is expected to happen by the end of the month.
